title: Kept decision, format version 1
description: A decision a person settled, with its reasons and where it came from, as one object. The id is a content address over the kernel; see README.md for how to compute and check it.

id.description: Kernel. The decision's own identifier, chosen by the implementation that kept it. The hosted service uses UUIDs.

statement.description: Kernel. The decision, in the words it was settled in.

authority_scope.description: Kernel. What the decision applies to, as tags. Order is part of the kernel.

is_standing.description: Lifecycle, not kernel. True when it applies across every project of its owner.

is_north_star.description: Lifecycle, not kernel. True when its owner marked it as a guiding aim.

venture_id.description: Lifecycle, not kernel. The project it belongs to, if any.

type.description: One of constraint, tension, prior_ruling, option_weighed, fact, precedent, principle, rejected_alternative, verbatim_quote. Readers must accept a value they do not know.

overall_why.description: Kernel. The reason, as the person confirmed it.

derivation_shape.description: Kernel. How the reasoning was reached, in one line, if recorded.

pillars.description: Kernel. The supporting points, in order. What was ruled out lives here as rejected_alternative.

wasGeneratedBy.description: Kernel. The deliberation that produced it.

wasDerivedFrom.description: Kernel. Sources it cites, in order.

ratifiedBy.description: Kernel. The person who made it canon. Never a model.

ratifiedAt.description: Kernel. When they did, as an ISO 8601 UTC string with milliseconds.

proposerModel.description: Kernel. The model that proposed the wording, if any.

proposedAt.description: Kernel. When it was proposed, if recorded.

wasRevisionOf.description: Lifecycle, not kernel. The one decision it replaced, or null when it replaced none or several.

wasRevisionOfAll.description: Lifecycle, not kernel. Every decision it replaced, sorted.

supersededBy.description: Lifecycle, not kernel. The decision that replaced it, if retired.
